max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous rsync connections allowed server-wide.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for rsync daemon messages. Set to stdout for console logging (not recommended for production daemons).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging. Common values: daemon, local0 through local7.

modules.description: List of rsync export modules (directories) to make available for transfer.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the directory to export via this module.

comment.description: Human-readable description of this module shown to rsync clients.

read_only.description: If true, clients cannot write or modify files in this module.

write_only.description: If true, clients can only write (not read) files. Set only for upload-only endpoints.

list.description: If true, this module appears in the module list when a client lists available exports.

max_connections.description: Per-module max connections. If 0, uses the global max_connections value.

users.description: List of allowed usernames (must exist on server). Leave empty to disable user restriction (not recommended).

groups.description: List of allowed group names (GIDs) for file access permissions.

owner.description: Username (UID) to assign as owner to all files uploaded. Use only if necessary (e.g., for web serving).

file_permissions.description: How to handle file permissions: 'preserve' (default), 'force', or 'ignore'.

lock_file.description: Path to a per-module lock file (prevents concurrent writes).

max_size.description: Maximum file size (in bytes) allowed for transfer in this module. 0 = unlimited.

exclude.description: List of glob/regex patterns to exclude during transfers (relative to module path).

include.description: List of glob/regex patterns to explicitly include (override excludes).

auth_realm.description: Authentication realm name (used in MD5 challenge for rsync auth).

secrets_file.description: Path to the secrets file containing username:password (or MD5 hashes) for authentication.

hide_dot_files.description: If true, dotfiles (e.g., .git) are hidden from listing and default syncs.

use_chroot.description: If true, use chroot() to isolate this module’s process (strongly recommended for security).

timeout.description: Idle timeout (seconds) before disconnecting inactive clients.

transfer_rate.description: Maximum transfer rate (KB/s) for clients using this module. 0 = unlimited.
